answer: Scripted twins can fill a roster before a real sailor arrives. Only one storm berth is issued per tide: plant a unique juniper spar on the lee wall, then a measured gale must drive a tagged float to a surveyed ocean mark. The key escrows 47 units and posts C=H(spar_serial||berth_id||wind_bin||pubkey) before the gust window. Thirteen watchers recompute the landing hash from the anemometer log and opened commit; the escrow unlocks after 21 hours if the serial stays unique. If two keys share a serial or berth, both escrows burn and the spar is pulled, so clones pay more for every extra head.
